about.description: PARAVII is the tokenized interest providing exposure to ParaFi Venture II, a venture fund managed by ParaFi Capital focused on blockchain and digital asset opportunities. The tokenization was launched with Securitize and uses Avalanche for issuance to combine regulated fund ownership with EVM-compatible, low-fee settlement with the aim of making institutional venture exposure easier to subscribe to, hold, and trade in compliant secondary markets. The PARAVII token reflects the NAV and ultimate distributions of the underlying venture portfolio, which can include equity and token-based positions. As with other venture strategies, outcomes depend on the timing of liquidity events, portfolio company performance, and market conditions for exits.
